title: Team retro: mobile app launch (35 min)

clusters.name: Launch recap
points: Release went out two days late after the store review asked for a privacy label
Day-one crash rate 0.4%, mostly on old Android versions
quotes: "the review took longer than the build"
actions: ✓ Add the privacy label to the release checklist

clusters.name: Crash triage
points: Two crashes cover 80% of reports: image cache on low memory, a race in sign-in
Repro needs a real low-memory device; the emulator hides it
actions: ✓ Hotfix the image cache this week

clusters.name: Onboarding drop-off
points: Half of new users leave at step 3 (permissions screen)
Idea: ask for permissions later, when a feature needs them
quotes: "we ask for everything before we have earned anything"

clusters.name: Process and on-call
points: Night pages were mostly duplicates from two alerting rules
Handover notes help; nobody reads the long ones

clusters.name: Next quarter
points: Tablet layout requested by the biggest customers
Offline mode is the most voted feature
actions: ? Tablet or offline first: decide next week
